items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I got to hear Whiteman later on... Ross Gorman, he played it and I still think he plays it -- he understands it.

ctx.x: I am going back before you, I can see that.
Well, he had Ross Gorman and PeeWee Byers, they called him.
Ross Gorman's name I'm familiar with.
